rows.name: North Dakota State Board of Medical Examiners
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines North Dakota's physicians and physician assistants. Thirteen members appointed by the Governor — nine MDs, one DO, one physician assistant, and two public members (N.D.C.C. 43-17).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the North Dakota Century Code; ND publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: North Dakota State Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: North Dakota home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates North Dakota's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor, three of whom must be active real estate brokers (N.D.C.C. 43-23-01).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the North Dakota Century Code; ND publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
